edges.root_basis: A ROOT, DELIBERATELY, AND THIS IS THE ONE DECISION IN THIS FIXTURE WORTH ARGUING ABOUT. Sacrae disciplinae leges abrogated the 1917 Code, so an edge from the 1917 line could be drawn and defended. It is not drawn here, because an edge in this record is what makes the generator diff one state against another canon by canon — and the two Codes do not share a numbering. The diff would print c. 1095 of 1983 against c. 1095 of 1917 as though one had become the other, which is a correspondence nobody claims. Two roots say the true thing: one body of law replaced another, and this record maps no canon of either onto the other.
